keys.instructions.page.title: XIRO! - Instructions
keys.instructions.hero.title: How to Play XIRO!
keys.instructions.hero.subtitle: Learn about our dynamics and types of questions
keys.instructions.game_modes.bank.title: 1. Question Bank
keys.instructions.game_modes.bank.description: Questions are taken from a specific bank and presented to players completely randomly. Ideal for reviewing a specific topic.
keys.instructions.game_modes.mix.title: 2. Mix of Questions
keys.instructions.game_modes.mix.description: It allows you to select several question banks and choose how many random questions to extract from each one. Selected questions will be mixed in a random order when presented.
keys.instructions.game_modes.custom.title: 3. Custom Games
keys.instructions.game_modes.custom.descripti: You are in control. You choose the questions one by one from the different banks and configure their exact order of appearance for a structured presentation.
keys.instructions.game_modes.trivial.title: 4. Trivial
keys.instructions.game_modes.trivial.descript: Classic board mode! A die is rolled and the token moves forward. Depending on which box you land on, a random question from the category corresponding to the color of the box will be presented.
keys.instructions.question_types.quiz.title: Quiz
keys.instructions.question_types.quiz.descrip: Classic question with several possible answers, but only one is correct.
keys.instructions.question_types.survey.title: Survey
keys.instructions.question_types.survey.descr: No right or wrong answers. It serves to collect the opinion of the audience by presenting different options.
keys.instructions.question_types.numeric.desc: Players must enter a number trying to get as close as possible to the exact winning value.
keys.instructions.question_types.order.title: Sort Sequence (Order)
keys.instructions.question_types.order.descri: A list of elements is presented that the player must drag and place in the correct logical order.
keys.instructions.question_types.word_scrambl: The challenge is to find a hidden word by ordering the disordered letters that appear on the screen.
keys.instructions.question_types.multiple.des: Similar to the Quiz, but in this case there can be between 1 and 6 correct answers simultaneously.
Find the words hidden in a 10x10 grid in any direction. Every word found scores points. Tap a word to see where it starts, but it will be worth half.
